description: A panoramic ground-level photograph displays a serene, bright blue lake nestled within a mountainous, forested landscape. The lake is surrounded by steep, densely vegetated hillsides with dark green coniferous and deciduous trees. In the distance, a range of rugged, snow-capped mountains rises under a clear, light blue sky. On the right side of the image, along the lake's shore and extending up the hillside, a small cluster of buildings forms a settlement, characterized by traditional architecture with pitched roofs. This image visually represents a natural lake environment, aligning with the "8.2 Lakes and reservoirs" and "8.2.1 Natural lakes" categories discussed in the accompanying Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) nomenclature guidelines. No text or specific labels are visible within the image.
